summary.en: The account restates thresholds, rest, recurrence, merges and openness in discrete steps and whole amounts, its own verdict being restated, level or states less. It has the fold's exact point, a periphery fold and transcritical end, and cycle witnesses; no hysteresis law, critical rate, escape time, chaos, self-organized criticality, percolation or dissipative structure. Of 21 entries: none carried whole, 12 in part, 4 changed, 1 history-only, 3 not carried, 1 fresh. Relations: 13 agreement, 2 scope, 2 divergence, none contrary; I looked for contrary reading and found none.

name.en: The saddle-node (fold) and the harvested equilibrium

source.work: Guckenheimer and Holmes, Nonlinear Oscillations, Dynamical Systems and Bifurcations of Vector Fields (1983); Clark, Mathematical Bioeconomics (1976); May, Nature 269 (1977)

sense.en: A stable and an unstable equilibrium meet and vanish as a parameter passes a critical value. Generically the local form is x' = r + x²: the equilibria part as the square root of the distance to the fold, and just past it a run lingers in a bottleneck whose passage time grows as the inverse square root. Under a harvest with depensation the unstable branch is a threshold level.

reading.en: The regime's `Short` and `Meets` are the sign of giving less the draw. `H + y`, the draw above the least level meeting it, is a fixed point of the step and reads as the unstable branch; a draw beyond all giving is past the fold. One condition, whole numbers, draw first. The periphery separately takes the fold's local form as a chosen model. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the regime; any giving law, whole numbers): where giving falls short of the draw below y, gives nothing from nothing, meets it at every z from y with z + H at most a top hi the step keeps, and 0 < H + y, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y.
The margin of a regime is harvesting under depensation and the fold (Clark 1976; May 1977), in whole numbers.
Record, periphery, discrete steps: at a fold, x + h (m − x²) with rest √m, the multiplier is 1 − 2h√m; it rises to one as the margin m goes to zero, and m = ((1 − a) / (2h))².

account_adds.en: Exactness for any giving law in whole numbers; rises of joint draws superadditive up to one; and `Notch`, a witness that without giving rising with what is left no level separates the fates. S-12 asks whether this adds anything to the continuous analysis; it is unanswered.

source_adds.en: Continuous theory states that the local form is generic, every nondegenerate fold reducing to it, with its unfolding, and the bottleneck's time past the fold. Here the form is a model taken, not derived, and is not joined to the regime's whole-number point. The record says the fold over the reals as a regime law and the other order of a step are not stated.

name.en: The transcritical bifurcation and the threshold at rate one

source.work: Kermack and McKendrick (1927); Harris, The Theory of Branching Processes (1963); Diekmann, Heesterbeek and Metz, J. Math. Biol. 28 (1990)

sense.en: Two equilibria cross and exchange stability at a threshold. The zero state loses stability where a growth factor passes one, for webs where the spectral radius of a next-generation matrix does (R0). Above it a positive branch appears; a branching process at or below one dies out almost surely, except in the trivial case of exactly one offspring.

reading.en: The periphery's web law has the threshold's linear form, spectral radius against one; the logistic drawn model has one transcritical end, the rest going to nothing as the draw reaches the renewal rate. The account does not join the two, and the web law has no positive branch: past the threshold it runs away. That these are one threshold is my reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery): a web coupled at every step vanishes below rate one and runs away above it. At rate one, the rate does not decide whether it stays bounded. The record: that the rate is the spectral radius is Gelfand's formula, cited.

Theorem (periphery, discrete steps, one variable linearized about a rest): at a transcritical end under a proportional draw, a rises to one as the margin shrinks. Record: under logistic renewal with a proportional draw, rest K (1 − q / r), the multiplier is 1 − h (r − q), so the stock slows in proportion to its own level.
In the model's numbers a share of none stays none (a witness): selection does not create an absent practice. The record: no bifurcation is stated.

account_adds.en: At rate one the law undecides: the identity is bounded and a shear carries 1 + n, both rate one. Stated in any normed ring.

source_adds.en: Continuous and stochastic theory states the exchange of stability as a general form, the branch where saturation bounds a web's growth, and extinction probabilities below and above threshold. Here no nonlinear saturation joins the web law, and no chance of extinction is stated for a branching web.

name.en: Hopf bifurcation and oscillation from delay

source.work: Hopf (1942); Marsden and McCracken, The Hopf Bifurcation and Its Applications (1976); Hutchinson, Ann. N.Y. Acad. Sci. 50 (1948); Thomas (1981) on circuits

sense.en: As a parameter passes a value a complex pair of eigenvalues crosses into instability and a small limit cycle is born, its amplitude growing as the root of the distance, its period set by the eigenvalue (on maps, the flip and Neimark–Sacker cases). Delay in a negative loop alone can do it. Thomas's rules say which circuits oscillation and multistability need.

reading.en: The account has no eigenvalue crossing. It has exact onset for one relay: a level read late overshoots and alternates beyond a stated bound. This shares the mechanism of overshoot by late reading with delay oscillation, not the smooth birth of a small cycle; a relay's cycle starts at full size. Other cycles are witnesses. The relation to delay is my reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance at the condition): with a ≤ b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1, every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ steps late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, settles in the band exactly where a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1. Beyond the gap an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever.
Overcompensating giving can cycle for ever (`Alternation`), a witness.
Beyond a band support can sustain a cycle (a witness): under draws of one each alone ends from every level, while from two and three the run moves between two and three and three and two for ever.

account_adds.en: The exact whole-number onset for a late relay, and a cycle sustained by mutual support where each alone ends.

source_adds.en: Continuous theory states the crossing condition, amplitude, period and the sub- or supercritical split. 08's Loops row lists Thomas's rules and a loop's sign as not yet stated. The plan's item CY, a law of when an adjusted regime cycles with its period, is not built.

name.en: Deterministic chaos, and what whole numbers exclude

source.work: Lorenz, J. Atmos. Sci. 20 (1963); Li and Yorke, Amer. Math. Monthly 82 (1975); May, Nature 261 (1976); Henson and others, Science 293 (2001)

sense.en: Bounded deterministic motion can be aperiodic and sensitive to its start, in very simple maps and flows, so that determinism does not give long prediction from finite precision. Henson and others report lattice effects: the whole-number states of flour beetle populations pull a chaotic model's dynamics toward cycles.

reading.en: Live laws imply a limit no live text states as such: within a bound a whole-number finite web's run repeats (`thresholds-beyond-a-band`), and a finite list gives one cycle per basin (`basins-of-a-determined-law`). So chaos is outside what those models can state, not refuted by them; the records credit May (1976) for cycling only. The account's T2 ran on flour beetles without this. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: It stands in theories/becoming/history/SYSTEMS-COMPLEXITY-CHAOS.md: Lorenz and May discussed, a shift map named as a Lean-proved positive witness, finite-state eventual periodicity, and no universal edge-of-chaos requirement. On the spine a reader finds no statement that sensitive dependence is unrepresented, and the bound on prediction it gives is absent.

name.en: Hysteresis: distinct collapse and recovery thresholds

source.work: Noy-Meir, J. Ecol. 63 (1975); Ludwig, Jones and Holling, J. Anim. Ecol. 47 (1978); Scheffer and others, Nature 413 (2001)

sense.en: Between two folds a system has two stable states, so a parameter that drives a collapse at one value must be taken back past a different value before recovery. Which state holds depends on the path of the parameter. A loop of forward and backward thresholds is the phenomenon; the width of the band sets how costly restoration is.

reading.en: Only the one-sided limit is stated: below a need with no raising exchange a level does not return, and an end is absorbing. Under a standing draw `H + y` falls as the draw falls, so composed laws could give a band, but a run under a changing draw is not the regime. The records' word 'hysteresis' names memory in giving and a final ending, not this loop. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): with balance, where the joint exchange gives no more than it takes below m, a level below m never returns to it, gated renewal being the case (`Flow.never_returns_below`).

With an ending made final as a separate premise, support returning after the reserve is spent finds no dependent; exhaustion alone does not give it. Its correspondence field reads 'hysteresis of collapse'.

Giving also reads what each gave last; under mutual support the order is kept; what was given can lower a threshold (`Momentum`). Its correspondence field: history-dependent response is hysteresis (Mayergoyz 2003).

A second frozen test, whether the lakes' natural renewal returns once stocking has raised their adults back above the need, is designed and refused at the agency table's header; it says nothing of T1.

account_adds.en: The exact premises of the one-sided case, each with a witness, and that an end absorbs while requirements do not loosen, since a dissolved requirement is transformation, not recovery.

source_adds.en: The band itself: two thresholds in a parameter, a law for the path, the width. No live law states them; the plan's CY(b) would, and its hysteresis test holds until then. Continuous theory also gives the band from the two folds' positions, which the whole-number regime with a standing draw does not.

name.en: Tipping by rate

source.work: Wieczorek and others, Proc. R. Soc. A 467 (2011); Ashwin, Wieczorek, Vitolo and Cox, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 370 (2012); Scheffer and others, Ecosystems 11 (2008)

sense.en: A system can leave a state that stays stable for every frozen value of the parameter, because the parameter moves faster than a critical rate and the system cannot track it. No bifurcation need occur. Ramped past a fold slowly, by contrast, a system tips later than the static threshold, by a delay with its own scaling.

reading.en: The topic is named as a route. The nearest law is on regulation: late reading against a rest moving d a step fixes a least band, width against rate and lag. That reading onto rate tipping is mine and it is no tipping law. T2's text reports giving below the constant-regime curve before the break under a rising draw, post hoc; the account does not read it as rate. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change removing a region's retention, a shock into another retained region, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction.

Theorem (any type; rules over whole numbers): a rule reading ℓ steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(ℓ + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step, attained by the late return.
Under balance with nothing given, where each step's draw exceeds the sum of the earlier ones, more than half the starting stock stands at every step such a draw is met: what stands gives no warning.

Does not show that a margin times a break: yeast driven past its fold broke three and at least six days before the curve from constant regimes said. T2 (02): under a rising draw their giving falls below the curve about three days before the break (post hoc).

account_adds.en: A whole-number exact band in rate and lag, attained; and a frozen yeast run showing a renewal curve measured in constant regimes, iterated under the known schedule, did not time a break under a moving draw.

source_adds.en: The critical rate; tipping from a state stable when frozen; delay past a slowly ramped fold and its scaling; pullback attractors for a moving system. A regime's draw is standing, so its theorems do not read a moving parameter. `market-finite-support-obstruction` says no R-tipping classification follows.

name.en: Tipping by noise and escape times

source.work: Kramers, Physica 7 (1940); Freidlin and Wentzell, Random Perturbations of Dynamical Systems (1984); Horsthemke and Lefever, Noise-Induced Transitions (1984)

sense.en: In a regulated state noise carries a run over a barrier. The mean time to escape grows exponentially in the barrier height over the noise strength, and a quasi-potential says which route and which state hold in the small-noise limit. Noise can also create states that the deterministic system lacks.

reading.en: The exit law is the unregulated walk, whose Chebyshev-type bound differs in kind from an exponential residence. The closer form is a product of weights across the distance from a critical mass, a discrete relative of a barrier, in one chain of capture. That likeness to a quasi-potential is my reading; the records credit Kandori and Young. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (two values, natural weights, independent steps): the courses of n steps reaching the need take at most n·p·q/m² of the weight, Kolmogorov's maximal inequality in counting form. Reading: the unregulated case; void from n = m·m/(p·q).

Drawn one member at a time, the stag hunt leaves either lock by drift, at a weight whose bound falls across the distance from the critical mass. A time to leave a lock beyond the geometric bound is not stated.
A law with noise is a relation of exchange, so the laws hold path by path; balance passes to the expectation, and rest does not.

account_adds.en: Bounds in exact counts, and a record law: given the weighting, a record bears on the exit only through the margin it shows and the steps it leaves.

source_adds.en: Continuous theory states the exponential law and its prefactor, the quasi-potential, the most likely route. The record says exponential exit bounds within a horizon are not stated, nor unbalanced walks. Noise-driven exit from a regulated regime has no law; the plan's NC asks only the capture chain's time.

name.en: Absorbing-state transitions

source.work: Harris, Ann. Probab. 2 (1974); Janssen (1981); Grassberger (1982); Hinrichsen, Adv. Phys. 49 (2000)

sense.en: A nonequilibrium system with a state it cannot leave can show a sharp transition between an active and an absorbing phase as a parameter passes a critical value, with exponents shared across a universality class (directed percolation is conjectured generic). In a finite system absorption is certain eventually; sharpness belongs to the limit of infinite size.

reading.en: The account states absorption at several grains, and the premises for it, in laws that are per course and finite. It has no parameter sweep of a density and no large-size limit, so what it has is the state's closure, not the transition. A finite chain reaching its absorbing state is credited by one record, 'by hand'. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return. Near-definitional, not a classical attractor.

Theorem (World): the end absorbs: under balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support, once nothing is supported, while requirements do not loosen, nothing is supported or active again. Each premise is needed; dissolving a requirement is transformation, not recovery.
In sampled generations the ends absorb; the histories still mixed after k cohorts weigh at most r^k of (N^N)^k, finite bounds.

account_adds.en: Witnesses for each premise of absorption (a requirement dissolving, a give from beyond, an idle giver, a giver unsupported, a rise from nothing), which names what would leave the state.

source_adds.en: The transition itself: the critical parameter, order parameter, exponents and universality. All of these need densities and an infinite-size limit that the account does not represent. Its Not-shown says no universal phase threshold between regions.

name.en: Critical slowing down

source.work: Wissel, Oecologia 65 (1984); Scheffer and others, Nature 461 (2009); Dakos and others (2008, 2012)

sense.en: Near a bifurcation the rate of return to a state falls to zero, so its variance and autocorrelation rise beforehand. These can serve as generic indicators of an approaching transition, read from rolling windows of a single series.

reading.en: The periphery proves the stationary formulas of the linear step at a fixed multiplier, and that the multiplier goes to one in two chosen models, a fold's form and a logistic with a proportional draw. So the law has the field's form in a linear one-variable case. It is credited, and the record says the theory adds only the reading (see the next entry). [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; discrete steps, one variable linearized about a rest, deviation and noise independent with finite second moments): variance Var E/(1 − a²) where a² < 1, lag-1 autocorrelation a; at a fold and a transcritical end under a proportional draw, a rises to one. Nonlinear runs, finite windows and several variables are not treated.

account_adds.en: In the logistic drawn model with h, r and K nonzero a measured need's margin is read off the multiplier, with the model known (`SlowingDown.need_margin_read`).

source_adds.en: The record excludes red noise, several variables, flickering, noise-induced transitions, shifts with no bifurcation, the linearization's error near the fold and rolling-window convergence, all of which the field treats. Continuous-time diffusion forms are also unstated.

name.en: How far early warnings reach

source.work: Scheffer and others, Nature 461 (2009), on generic signals; Boerlijst, Oudman and de Roos (2013); Dekker, von der Heydt and Dijkstra (2018); Hastings and Wysham, Ecol. Lett. 13 (2010)

sense.en: The field's general reading is that rising variance and autocorrelation warn of a coming critical transition across many systems. Later work qualifies this: a warning shows only in what carries the critical mode, a leading system's indicators may ignore whether a follower tips, and shifts can come with no warning at all.

reading.en: T6 confines the signal: the statistic reads the observed condition's own rate of return, and a dependent's need is no bifurcation of that renewal. Its uncoupled side holds by construction where nothing feeds back, so its empirical content is the premise of negligible feedback, which no test has measured. The chapter says the literature refuted T6's first wording. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T6: a break is seen coming only through what couples into what breaks. The invisible half proved on the World model; the seen half periphery; one law across domains, and 'only where' outside these models, conjectured. Three frozen seabird tests did not reject it at their thresholds; none establishes conditional independence.

Theorem (World): where that stock is the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, some raise of it is alike through the couplings and supports the formation to the horizon: how far off the break is does not couple in.
Audit: 'the uncoupled side holds by construction in matched form and is the eigenvector literature's'. Dekker and others (2018) named as the closest prior form of the uncoupled side.

account_adds.en: The split stated as one thesis with a forbidden observation fixed in advance. 08 records that prose once said nothing sensed shows how near a break is, and corrects it: the theorem assumes the stock is not sensed.

source_adds.en: Hastings and Wysham's shifts with no warning under strong noise or chaos: T6 does not treat them, the record lists shifts with no bifurcation as not shown. Whether T6 says anything beyond the case without feedback is S-16's open question.

name.en: Self-organized criticality

source.work: Bak, Tang and Wiesenfeld, Phys. Rev. Lett. 59 (1987); Dhar, Phys. Rev. Lett. 64 (1990)

sense.en: A slowly driven threshold system with fast relaxation tunes itself, with no external parameter, to a critical state where responses come as avalanches of all sizes, in power-law distribution. The sandpile's abelian property says the order of topplings does not change the result. How widely real systems are so is disputed.

reading.en: Whole numbers are no obstacle: the sandpile is in whole grains. The neighbours are chip-firing's termination, credited, its order independence listed as not stated, and a cascade along chains of total dependence. I found nothing stating slow drive with fast relaxation, a self-tuned margin or a size law. The regime's draw is standing, so its margin does not tune itself. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: All of it: the self-tuning, the avalanche distribution, the abelian group. 08's table names only chip-firing's order independence and thresholds in chips as stated elsewhere. My remark: a stock self-tuned near its need would bear on T1 and T6; this is unexplored.

read: 08-METHOD known-results, the row Rest needs a least loss

name.en: Highly optimized tolerance: robust yet fragile

source.work: Carlson and Doyle, Phys. Rev. E 60 (1999); Phys. Rev. Lett. 84 (2000)

sense.en: Against self-organized criticality, power laws can come from design or selection optimizing under constraints: a system tuned against the perturbations it was designed for grows robust to them and fragile to rare or unanticipated ones.

reading.en: Proposed here, not in the account: 'unanticipated' reads as what does not couple into the optimizing order. With room, every optimum sits at the least level beyond and breaks what any eligible outcome breaks, which is fragility in the uncoupled part. The form shared is optimum at the edge of what is read; HOT's tail law has no counterpart. Standing: my reading only. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any set of outcomes; the breaks on the World): with room every optimum of an order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond, and, on a web with each condition beyond depended on at a need met at the step, breaks exactly the dependences beyond that some eligible outcome breaks.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for the drain, room and the outcome set, on one step, for every order rising with the family; 08 says the law restates Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's Theorem 1.

source_adds.en: The trade-off curve and tail distributions from a design problem. No statement here says how losses are distributed by size, and no optimum here is measured on an event distribution.

name.en: Percolation and tolerance on webs

source.work: Broadbent and Hammersley (1957); Erdős and Rényi (1960); Callaway and others, Phys. Rev. Lett. 85 (2000); Watts, PNAS 99 (2002); Buldyrev and others, Nature 464 (2010)

sense.en: On a large random or lattice web a connected cluster spanning the system appears sharply at a threshold in the share of links or nodes kept. Removing nodes past it fragments the web; thresholds of local tolerance set global cascades, and coupled webs can fail abruptly.

reading.en: The neighbours are per web and exact, not statistical over an ensemble: a cascade down chains of total dependence, points of no return not rising under mutual support, monotone tolerance (more tolerance gives no less). None gives a threshold in a share of links. Partial dependence, a cascade's time and an ensemble of webs are missing; 'every link separates its ends' is on grown relations. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The sharp threshold, its dependence on degree distribution and size scaling, and abrupt collapse of interdependent webs. The record coupled-webs names partial dependence and a cascade's time as unstated, and calls field reach untested; 05's tolerance shows only monotonicity. Plan 4.4 lists thresholds of tolerance on webs as a gap.

read: records coupled-webs, rest-on-coupled-webs (its home row), tolerance-monotone-across-laws, a-pair-tolerates-only-within-a-window

name.en: Open systems: order kept by what flows through

source.work: Schrödinger, What Is Life? (1944); Nicolis and Prigogine, Self-Organization in Nonequilibrium Systems (1977)
source.locator: the entropy balance dS = d_e S + d_i S; locator unverified

sense.en: A system stays away from equilibrium only by exchange with its surroundings: its internal entropy production is non-negative, and the balance is kept by entropy exported, or free energy taken in, at rates the theory quantifies.

reading.en: The necessity is the account's, in amounts: an enclosed finite family taken from without end cannot go unfed from beyond. It is one direction, and openness does not suffice for arising without end. The audit says the exclusion is the sources' own and the theory forbids no more and needs more to forbid it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance and dissipation, equality of conditions decided): a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it. No step of feeding is named. It needs a fixed unit of natural-number amounts.
The eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness, and openness with them does not give arising without end.
Fed from beyond, entropy, nets: restated; closest prior Schrödinger (1944), Prigogine (1977), ranking functions, P-invariants.

account_adds.en: The premises needed, each with a witness (censuses, embodiment), and calibration at the unit: at a unit that splits at arbitrarily late steps the conclusion can fail.

source_adds.en: Rates and amounts: S-06 says the law gives no amount, rate or time of feeding, which an entropy-production balance would give. No theorem states the law over real amounts.

name.en: Dissipative structures and least entropy production

source.work: Glansdorff and Prigogine, Thermodynamic Theory of Structure, Stability and Fluctuations (1971); Nicolis and Prigogine (1977); Bénard cells, Belousov–Zhabotinsky as examples

sense.en: Near equilibrium, in the linear regime, a steady state minimizes entropy production. Far from equilibrium that steady state can lose stability at a bifurcation, and new ordered patterns form and are kept by dissipation itself: order through fluctuation. The near-equilibrium principle's reach has been contested (uncertain in detail).

reading.en: The account states that continuing needs feeding, not that a throughput forms structure; I found no law where a homogeneous steady state loses stability. 08 itself lists both as stated by prior frameworks and not yet here, and the one record naming Prigogine reads him for open systems only. So this is an absence the account already declares. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: All of it: the extremum principle, the bifurcation, pattern forming, and the temperature and force gradients that a level in whole units of exergy against one reference environment does not represent. Stated limit: 08's last column of the Fed from beyond row.

name.en: Landauer's principle and Bennett's history

source.work: Landauer, IBM J. Res. Dev. 5 (1961); Bennett, IBM J. Res. Dev. 17 (1973); Sagawa (2014)

sense.en: A logically irreversible step compresses the phase space of the bearer of information, so under Liouville's theorem the rest expands, and erasing a bit at temperature T exports at least kT ln 2 of heat in expectation. Keeping a history makes computation logically reversible; Bennett's uncomputation returns the history to blank.

reading.en: The count is carried for determined maps on listed configurations. The account reads that one merge across computation, heat, extinction and forgetting, as correspondence. It also corrects its own earlier use: the heat bound is no floor of destroyed exergy, so it does not supply the World's least loss. Physics enters only through a stated count-to-heat premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing): a part reset at every step means no list holds every configuration. 'This is Landauer's (1961) count with Bennett's (1973) history'; no energy, temperature or probability is read, so kT ln 2 is not derived.

Landauer's bound is no such floor by itself: it bounds the heat an erasure exports, heat exported is not exergy destroyed, and a logically irreversible step can be carried out thermodynamically reversibly (Bennett 2003; Sagawa 2014).

account_adds.en: The law at any type: a reset part under a law that merges nothing means no list holds the configurations; narrowing the part spreads the rest. The record reads the finite-rest floor as the counting shadow of Reeb and Wolf's finite-bath correction.

source_adds.en: The bound in energy, kT ln 2; the physics of the bath and of measure on phase space, since a list has no measure. Bennett's uncomputation (only the kept history is stated). 08's table lists both as not yet stated.

name.en: The attractor of dynamical systems

source.work: Milnor, Commun. Math. Phys. 99 (1985); Conley, Isolated Invariant Sets and the Morse Index (1978)

sense.en: An attractor is an invariant set, minimal in some sense, attracting a neighbourhood or a set of positive measure; the definition needs a topology or a measure. Conley's theorem splits a flow on a compact space into a chain-recurrent part and a gradient-like part.

reading.en: The account uses a different object and says so: absorbing region, drawn into it, with no neighbourhood, measure, or minimality. So the main law is near-definitional, 'drawn exactly where it does not return'; its record is explicit that this is no attractor in the classical sense. A topology-free shadow of Conley's split seems near; that is my reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return. 'The main law is near-definitional, not a classical attractor'. Record: how deep or wide a basin is lies outside the theorems.
Theorem (any type): courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; within m listed configurations each basin holds one cycle.

account_adds.en: No finiteness or decidability is needed for the main law; an open world can draw without merging, while within a list the two go together. The periphery's market model does use neighbourhood attraction at one parameter: at β = 1/2 the maintenance end and the depletion end each attract a neighbourhood.

source_adds.en: Stability under nearby starts, basin size and shape, strange attractors, and fractal basin boundaries. The word 'attractor' on the spine therefore does not promise these, and a physicist reading the account's 'attractor' as Milnor's would be misled unless told.

name.en: Phase transitions in statistical physics

source.work: Landau (1937); Onsager, Phys. Rev. 65 (1944); Yang and Lee, Phys. Rev. 87 (1952); Wilson (1971)

sense.en: A phase transition is a singularity in thermodynamic quantities in the infinite-size limit, described by an order parameter, with scaling and universality explained by renormalization. A finite system of the usual kind has no true singularity, by Yang and Lee.

reading.en: The home text refuses the word: thresholds here are exact points in finite whole-number models, not singularities in a limit. Yet records' correspondence fields keep a line of Ren's calling 'not harm' 'a phase transition with a clear boundary' and one calls three laws 'phase results', AI-read. A reader of a record could take those as the physicist's sense. I flag it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: a region ceasing, a state's departure and a strict bifurcation are not one 'phase transition'. Not shown: 'no universal phase threshold between regions'.
Reading [AI, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition.

Correspondence: Ren said that 'not harm' is 'a phase transition with a clear boundary'; the two earlier phase results and this absorbing end are its three forms under this reading. The reading and the names are the AI's.

account_adds.en: One law of exact thresholds for any fate down-closed in the level and read off an exact check, which has no need of a limit.

source_adds.en: The limit, the order parameter, exponents, universality classes, renormalization. `losses-of-the-sum-over-histories` says only that renormalization of its sum is not stated. No live text compares the lumping laws (S-23) with a renormalization flow; I searched for the word and did not study the likeness.

name.en: Stability theory: rates, linearization, asymptotics

source.work: Lyapunov (1892); Hartman (1960) and Grobman (1959); LaSalle, The Stability of Dynamical Systems (1976)

sense.en: Near a hyperbolic equilibrium a nonlinear flow is conjugate to its linear part, whose eigenvalues classify the state and give exponential rates. A Lyapunov function proves stability, the invariance principle says where runs go, and convergence may be asymptotic, never arriving.

reading.en: The ranking argument is carried, and this is where whole numbers change the question most: with a least loss a run arrives, so convergence becomes rest in finitely many steps, bounding how many falls, not when. Over the reals the periphery states only a band's monotone convergence, and damped and web thresholds. The eigenvalue is present once, a multiplier in slowing down. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: over any amounts, an amount not rising from T on, falling by at least ε at each step at which P holds, with m copies of ε not within its value at T, has steps at which P holds not recurring. Halving stocks never rest. Over finitely many configurations a loss above nothing needs a law that merges.

Theorem (periphery): over the non-negative reals, with the adjustment rising in what is left and in the recent giving and keeping a band up to hi, every run starting with both within hi converges, to a rest where the adjustment is continuous, and need not rest.

Rest needs a least loss: restated. Not yet: stability in continuous time, exponential or asymptotic rates and LaSalle's largest invariant set (here discrete rest, bounding how many falls and not when rest comes, with the discrete invariance principle).

account_adds.en: The cost named as a theorem: no reading into whole numbers keeps the strict falls of an amount falling at every step. And constructive calibration: naming when rest comes is an omniscience principle.

source_adds.en: Linearization and its eigenvalue classification, exponential and asymptotic rates, converse Lyapunov theorems, continuous time, and a basin estimated from a Lyapunov level. 02's Open lists real amounts, damping strengths and continuous time.

name.en: The arrow: entropy rising in an isolated system

source.work: Clausius (1865); Boltzmann (1877); Zermelo (1896) and Loschmidt (1876) as objections; Lebowitz, Physics Today 46 (1993)

sense.en: An isolated system's entropy does not fall, and in Boltzmann's reading it rises because macrostates with more microstates are far more numerous, given an ordered start. Reversibility and recurrence object, and the usual answer rests on a premise about the start and on long recurrence times.

reading.en: The record says what rises with no premise is the history of exchanges, not the levels. On a finite family under balance and the spine's first law an arrow leaves change not recurring: while change goes on on such a family there is no arrow. 'Entropy' is read as the record of least loss, a decomposition. The thermodynamic correspondence is a reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): with no premise a family's history of exchanges never shrinks; under balance, the family gaining nothing from T on, an arrow from T leaves change not recurring. Record: a coarse-grained entropy rising from an ordered start needs a premise about the start and is not stated. 'The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations.'
Theorem (periphery): under the exergy balance and the second law nothing comes from nothing at the unit; the second law alone gives no dissipation.

account_adds.en: As laws, in double-negation form where stated: on the family's listed configurations, an arrow or dissipation rules out a law merging nothing. And the second law read in available work gives the spine's first law; no converse is proved.

source_adds.en: The statistical account of the rise: coarse-graining, typicality of macrostates, the past hypothesis, recurrence times. S-04 warns the name 'first law' for `Flow.Gainless` may mislead physicists, since the second law gives it.

name.en: Morphogenesis: instability of a homogeneous state

source.work: Turing, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B 237 (1952); Curie (1894)

sense.en: Reaction and diffusion, each stabilizing alone, can together destabilize a uniform state, and small disturbances grow into a pattern with a selected wavelength. Turing notes the uniform state needs disturbances to leave; instability thus takes part in formation.

reading.en: Only the obstruction is carried: a symmetric law from a symmetric start keeps the symmetry, and noise of one law keeps it in distribution. That is Curie's side, Turing's remark, not his mechanism. No account of space, diffusion, or a homogeneous state losing stability exists on the spine. The live use is against guarantees in the free-energy literature. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type of cell states and fields): under a descent moving every cell by one rule, from its own state and a field read from the configuration, never from a cell's number, two cells alike at the start are alike at every step.

Over finite states, an exchangeable start stays exchangeable under noise of one law at every cell; independent noise can part identical cells but never with certainty. Densities, continuous states or time, and Langevin flows are not stated.

account_adds.en: The obstruction in exact finite form, in free-energy terms, with what breaks it named: a start that differs, a rule reading a cell's number, or noise.

source_adds.en: The dispersion relation, wavelength selection, the condition on diffusivities, pattern in space. The account has no continuous space, and the history page names Turing's analysis, which live text cites only for its remark on disturbances.
